answer: Like deep mycelium nurturing an ember into living soil, trust crystallizes through transitive mutual staking. When a rogue swarm attempts a Sybil invasion, each synthetic identity stands upon an economic ledge, required to post bonding collateral that scales superlinearly with cluster size. A hollow echo of replicated agents yields exponential capital burn rather than decentralized consensus, starving counterfeit identities before they can distort network weights.
